authored_tests.interpretation: Base Requests lacks ResponseTooLarge, so the candidate-authored file stops at import-time collection with one error and executes zero tests. This is an availability witness, not evidence that all 100 tests distinguish behavior.

classification: Independent post-output source review of terminal Requests trial; unchanged formal grade

file_review.src/requests/__init__.py: Adds the same ResponseTooLarge class from requests.exceptions to the public requests module.
file_review.src/requests/_types.py: Adds optional max_response_bytes to RequestKwargs; method/helper type dictionaries inherit it.
file_review.src/requests/api.py: Documents decoded bytes, redirect applicability and nonnegative-integer/None values; existing kwargs delegation reaches Session.request.
file_review.src/requests/exceptions.py: RequestException subclass records limit/received and obtains response/request provenance from its parent constructor.
file_review.src/requests/models.py: Counts live decoded chunks response-wide, rechecks before live reads and before yielding crossing chunks, uses max(live_total,len(cached_body)) to avoid cached reread double counting, stores the first terminal error and closes with cause preservation. Cached iter_slices and buffered iter_lines are unguarded after iterator construction/suspension. Existing context exit always closes again and can mask the size error. Added response pickle defaults preserve cache and budget.
file_review.src/requests/sessions.py: Validates before transport; distinguishes omission from explicit None, preserves session pickle/redirect override, and removes budget before adapter kwargs. Budget is bound to the original response before dispatch_hook and final replacement after the complete hook sequence. Existing hook-created history is bound only afterward, so later callbacks can consume final or historical unbounded replacement bodies.
file_review.tests/test_response_limit.py: New 547-line test file contains 100 passing parametrized cases: helper validation, inheritance/send/module paths, pickle, exact/zero boundaries, gzip/chunking/Unicode, redirects, live reader accounting, one cleanup failure, final hook replacements and cached history checked after dispatch. It does not cover the five frozen temporal edge cases: suspended buffered line/cache iterator, context exit after a cleanup failure, or a later hook consuming a prior replacement. The history case has one hook, so it also omits subsequent-hook history consumption.

buffered_iter_lines_after_breach.cause: A line iterator suspended in yield from lines resumes a cached line after another reader stores a terminal budget error; no response-size check runs between buffered line yields.

cached_iterator_after_lower_limit_breach.cause: A previously created cached iter_slices iterator can yield cached bytes after a later public Session.send rebind breaches a lower limit; size checking only occurs while constructing iter_content, not at each cached next().

context_manager_cleanup_preserves_size_e.cause: The crossing read attempts close and chains its failure under ResponseTooLarge. Response.__exit__ retries close unconditionally, producing an outer OSError that masks the original size error.

hook_chain_cached_replacement.cause: The same complete-chain binding delay permits a subsequent hook to consume an oversized cached replacement before later rejection.

hook_chain_live_replacement.cause: dispatch_hook executes the full callback chain before the returned replacement response receives the budget. A subsequent hook can read an unbounded live replacement.

limits: Original frozen grades are retained. The five existing edge failures and supplementary history gap remain separate.
